# Get Blogged by JoKi
> The only frontiers are in your mind

Get Blogged by JoKi (Jochen Kirstätter) is a technology blog focused on .NET development, Google AI & Gemini, software architecture, open source, and developer community.

## Main Sections
- [Home](https://jochen.kirstaetter.name/): Latest articles and blog posts
- [About](https://jochen.kirstaetter.name/about.html): Background, biography, and professional journey
- [Blog Archive](https://jochen.kirstaetter.name/blog.html): Complete historical post index
- [Community](https://jochen.kirstaetter.name/community.html): Developer communities, conferences, and meetups
- [Speaking](https://jochen.kirstaetter.name/speaking.html): Talks, presentations, and events

## Featured Topics
- [.NET Development](https://jochen.kirstaetter.name/tags/development.html)
- [Google AI & Gemini](https://jochen.kirstaetter.name/tags/development.html)
- [Community](https://jochen.kirstaetter.name/tags/community.html)
